purpose: Review-only comparison of one reproducible automatic LOD topology candidate and three final-material directions on the approved A2 player rig before production retopology, 120-frame sampling, or runtime integration.
camera: one measured orthographic gameplay camera pitched downward exactly 45 degrees
facing: twelve 30-degree source/candidate topology samples plus four cardinal world-yaw samples per material direction
lighting: identical controlled fixed-world key, fill, and rim lighting for every topology and material sample
prompt: Use the approved player identity and separate rifle without changing geometry, pose, camera, or framing. First validate a compact Godot meshoptimizer LOD topology candidate against the full source at twelve real yaws. Then render three bounded PBR material directions on the same passing candidate: M1 charcoal tactical composite with restrained cyan identifiers, M2 weathered light industrial salvage alloy with blue conduits, and M3 smoked ceramic stealth armor with concentrated cyan and magenta energy accents plus an amber-orange independent rifle.
negative_constraints: no claim that automatic LOD generation is hand-authored production retopology
no identity, body geometry, weapon geometry, grip, pose, scale, camera, framing, lighting, or world-yaw drift between material options
no screen-space weapon rotation, baked-in rifle, broad translucency, collapsed side or rear anatomy, detached hand, floating stock, or cropped silhouette
no 120-frame expansion, production atlas replacement, Player.gd change, collision change, or gameplay integration before review

references.role: accepted A2 multi-yaw geometry, deformation, grip, and exact-camera proof
prompt-library sample 27303: matte-black brutalist tactical composite and restrained visor reference
prompt-library sample 25446: light/dark industrial recovery-unit material blocking reference
prompt-library sample 27028: cyan and amber low-key material-light separation reference
